1.text: AI alignment in the shape of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is increasingly treated as a crucial ingredient for high performance large language models. Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has been positioned by recent literature as the canonical method for the RL part of RLHF. However, it involves both high computational cost and sensitive hyperparameter tuning. We posit that most of the motivational principles that led to the development of PPO are less of a practical concern in RLHF and advocate for a less computationally expensive method that preserves and even increases performance. We revisit the formulation of alignment from human preferences in the context of RL. Keeping simplicity as a guiding principle, we show that many components of PPO are unnecessary in an RLHF context and that far simpler REINFORCE-style optimization variants outperform both PPO and newly proposed “RL-free” methods such as DPO

7.text: Actor-critic algorithms, such as PPO, were motivated in formulation by the high variance observed in traditional RL settings. PPO leverages lower-variance estimators of the total trajectory return

7.text: In contrast, REINFORCE uses an unbiased Monte-Carlo estimator of the trajectory return that can have high variance in theory, especially if it is approximated with only a single sample, which is not frequently preferred in traditional Deep-RL environments. Recent work has offered a plethora of evidence that REINFORCE suffers from high variance and fails in the presence of large action spaces like NLP (Ranzato et al., 2016; Bahdanau et al., 2017; Ding & Soricut, 2017; Ammanabrolu & Hausknecht, 2020; Ammanabrolu et al., 2022; Martin et al., 2022; Korbak et al., 2022). However, we note that these findings were based on scenarios with poor conditioning when training from random or weak initialization as opposed to warm-starting it from a strong pre-trained model.
7.zh: 相比之下，REINFORCE 使用轨迹回报的无偏蒙特卡洛估计。它在理论上方差可以很高，尤其是只用一个样本去近似的时候；这在传统深度 RL 环境里通常不被优先采用。近期工作提供了大量证据，表明 REINFORCE 受高方差困扰，并且在像 NLP 这样动作空间很大的地方会失败（Ranzato et al., 2016; Bahdanau et al., 2017; Ding & Soricut, 2017; Ammanabrolu & Hausknecht, 2020; Ammanabrolu et al., 2022; Martin et al., 2022; Korbak et al., 2022）。不过我们注意到，这些结论来自条件很差的情形：从随机初始化或很弱的初始化开始训练，而不是从一个强预训练模型热启动。

7.text: Here, we question whether this empirical evidence holds for RLHF. We posit that this is not a practical concern in fine-tuning LLMs due to the extremely strong initialization of the policy (a pre-trained LLM). In this setting, strong initialization coupled with prompt conditioning leads to the concentration of probability mass on a few tokens at each generation step, even though the number of possible actions is in theory enormous (refer to Appendix A for further discussion on the effect of conditioning). 11.text: Modeling Partial Completions vs Full Generations
11.zh: 对部分补全建模，与对完整生成建模

11.text: As shown in Figure 2, we find that methods that do not model partial completions such as REINFORCE with baseline and RLOO, consistently outperform Vanilla PG and PPO where each token is modeled as an action (i.e. partial completions). Moreover, aside from their superior performance in reward optimization, these methods require loading one less model copy compared to Vanilla PG and PPO, and different means to create a baseline. This is because they eliminate the need for training a learned baseline and a value network, as required in Vanilla PG and PPO, respectively. This suggests that modeling partial sequences is unnecessary in the context of RLHF.
11.zh: 如图 2 所示，不对部分补全建模的方法，例如带基线的 REINFORCE 和 RLOO，稳定地超过把每个 token 建模成动作（也就是部分补全）的 Vanilla PG 和 PPO。除了奖励优化更好之外，这些方法相比 Vanilla PG 和 PPO 少加载一份模型，构造基线的方式也不一样。原因是它们不再需要训练一个学出来的基线，也不再需要价值网络，而这两者分别是 Vanilla PG 和 PPO 所要求的。这说明，在 RLHF 的语境里，对部分序列建模是不必要的。

15.text: At a high level, this work posits that the RLHF setting of fine-tuning an LLM has a strong initialization of the policy, which coupled with further conditioning on a prompt, alleviates historical concerns with high variance and large action spaces. We support this position with empirical results, showing that vanilla policy gradient REINFORCE (Vanilla PG) outperforms PPO although it is rarely used in traditional Deep-RL settings due to high variance. Furthermore, we revisit how the problem of learning from human preferences is modeled and empirically show that the REINFORCE estimator, despite its simplicity, enables high-quality reward optimization.
15.zh: 从高层来看，本文认为：微调 LLM 的 RLHF 设定里，策略有很强的初始化，再进一步以提示为条件，就缓解了历史上对高方差和大动作空间的那些担忧。我们用经验结果支持这一立场：普通策略梯度 REINFORCE（Vanilla PG）超过了 PPO，尽管由于方差高，它在传统深度 RL 设定里很少被使用。此外，我们重新审视“从人类偏好学习”这个问题是怎样被建模的，并在经验上表明：REINFORCE 估计量尽管简单，仍然能够做出高质量的奖励优化。

15.text: Finally, our experiments demonstrate that RLOO as a multi-sample extension of REINFORCE, outperforms RAFT, DPO, and PPO while retaining high robustness relative to iterative fine-tuning methods like RAFT — achieving a best of both worlds sweet spot.
15.zh: 最后，实验表明，作为 REINFORCE 多样本扩展的 RLOO，超过了 RAFT、DPO 和 PPO，同时相对 RAFT 这类迭代微调方法保持了很高的稳健性，从而落到一个两全其美的位置上。

15.text: As one of the limitations of our work, we do not study reward model (RM) over-optimization, which refers to the problem when the optimization trajectory of the proxy reward, diverges from the “gold” reward objective (Gao et al., 2022). This aspect has not been studied yet also for iterative fine-tuning methods such as RAFT and deserves a dedicated study. We leave this to future work.
15.zh: 作为本文的一项局限，我们没有研究奖励模型（RM）的过度优化，也就是代理奖励的优化轨迹偏离“真实”奖励目标的情形（Gao et al., 2022）。这一点对 RAFT 这类迭代微调方法同样还没有被研究过，值得单独做一篇工作。我们把它留给未来。

16.text: Another limitation is the exploration of the LOO baseline in a single token action framework, where partial sequences are modeled and intermediary rewards are provided. In this work, we show that modeling partial sequences is an unnecessary undertaking in the RLHF context where rewards are attributed only to full sequences.
16.zh: 另一项局限是，没有在“单个 token 就是一个动作”的框架里探索 LOO 基线，也就是对部分序列建模、并给出中间奖励的情形。本文表明，在奖励只赋予完整序列的 RLHF 语境下，对部分序列建模是不必要的。

16.text: Finally, we limit our work to simulated win-rates from an LLM but do not measure correlation with final human evaluation preferences. We also did not explore RL training using other rewards such as ROUGE, BLEU, or other metrics used in NLP.
16.zh: 最后，我们的工作只使用来自 LLM 的模拟胜率，没有衡量它和最终人类评估偏好之间的相关性。我们也没有探索用 ROUGE、BLEU 或其他 NLP 里常用的指标作为奖励来做 RL 训练。

24.text: To evaluate the hypothesis that probability mass is heavily concentrated and conditioning significantly narrows the likely generation space, we empirically study the characteristics of the output distributions and each generation step. We use the Llama SFT model used for the HH experiments
24.zh: 为了检验“概率质量高度集中，而且条件化会显著收窄很可能出现的生成空间”这一假设，我们从经验上研究输出分布以及每一个生成步的特征。所用的是 HH 实验里的那个 Llama SFT 模型

24.text: Probability Mass Concentration Figure 7 (Right) plots the total probability mass concentrated in the top {1, 16, 32, 64} tokens. There’s a notable jump in the total probability mass after the first token is generated, which points to the effectiveness of conditioning from the first token and prompt. From that point on, a significant (∼ 60%) portion of probability mass is put on only the single most probable token at each step, with more than ∼ 90% of the total mass being concentrated on the top 16 tokens, with diminishing increases that point for the top 32 & 64 tokens. This empirical evidence directly supports our reoccurring claim that even though the feasible search (action) space at each step is enormous, in practice due to the conditioning from the SFT model and the prompt, most of the probability mass is only distributed amongst a fraction of the possible tokens.
24.zh: 概率质量的集中。图 7（右）画出集中在前 {1, 16, 32, 64} 个 token 上的总概率质量。第一个 token 生成之后，总概率质量有一次明显跃升，说明来自第一个 token 以及提示的条件化是起作用的。从那以后，每一步都有相当大的一部分（约 60%）概率质量只放在最可能的那一个 token 上，超过约 90% 的总质量集中在前 16 个 token，而前 32 与前 64 个 token 上的增量则越来越小。这些经验证据直接支持我们反复提出的判断：尽管每一步可行的搜索（动作）空间极大，实践中由于 SFT 模型和提示带来的条件化，大部分概率质量只分布在全部可能 token 的一小部分上。

24.text: Low Entropy Figure 7 (Left) plots the Normalized Entropy Hˆ(X) = the entropy of the uniform distribution under the vocabulary-size. Similar to the jump in probability mass in Figure 7 right, as expected, the biggest the drop in entropy occurs right after the first token is generated and only slightly rises up to the end of the generation and is consistently low. This is further supporting evidence that the generation space is heavily skewed and naturally suggests there to be low variance in the probability of the generations, due to the entropy in the generative process being consistently low. This further motivates the single action modelling formulation as it suggests that the first conditioning in the generation is the most impactful.
24.zh: 低熵。图 7（左）画出归一化熵 Hˆ(X) = 词表规模下均匀分布的熵。和图 7 右图里概率质量的跃升类似，正如预期，熵下降最多发生在第一个 token 刚刚生成之后，此后直到生成结束只略微回升，并且一直很低。这进一步说明生成空间严重偏斜，也自然意味着各条生成在概率上的方差会比较低，因为生成过程的熵始终很低。这同样促使我们把生成建模成单一动作：它说明，生成过程里的第一次条件化影响最大。

25.text: Below are additional details on training and data preprocessing.
25.zh: 下面是训练和数据预处理的补充细节。

25.text: Data-preprocessing For each dataset, we filter out prompts that exceed a pre-specified length to minimize the occurrence of generations not containing the EOS token. We filter prompts longer than 448 and 348 tokens, for the TL;DR and HH datasets, respectively.
25.zh: 数据预处理。对每个数据集，我们滤掉超过预定长度的提示，尽量减少生成结果中不含 EOS token 的情况。对 TL;DR 和 HH 数据集，分别滤掉长于 448 个和 348 个 token 的提示。

25.text: SFT Training For the TL;DR Summarize dataset, we use the dedicated SFT split. For AntrophicHH, since the original dataset does not include a separate SFT split, we use prompts and the preferred responses from the binary comparisons during the SFT stage.
25.zh: SFT 训练。对 TL;DR Summarize 数据集，我们使用专门的 SFT 划分。对 Anthropic-HH，由于原始数据集没有单独的 SFT 划分，SFT 阶段使用二元比较中的提示和偏好回答。

25.text: This is consistent with prior work (Yuan et al., 2023; Dong et al., 2023; Rafailov et al., 2023).
25.zh: 这与先前工作一致（Yuan et al., 2023; Dong et al., 2023; Rafailov et al., 2023）。

25.text: In terms of training hyperparameters, for the Pythia models, similar to previous work (Touvron et al., 2023b; Bai et al., 2022a), we train for 2 epochs with an initial learning rate of 2e-5 in both summarization and dialogue tasks. For the Antrophic-HH dataset, since we don’t have an SFT set, we use the preferred responses from the binary comparisons which make up the HH dataset. This is consistent with prior work (Yuan et al., 2023; Dong et al., 2023; Rafailov et al., 2023). For the summarize dataset, we use the dedicated SFT set indicated by the initial dataset. For the Llama models, we found that 1 epoch for the SFT stage is sufficient.
25.zh: 训练超参数方面，对 Pythia 模型，与先前工作类似（Touvron et al., 2023b; Bai et al., 2022a），摘要任务和对话任务都训练 2 个 epoch，初始学习率为 2e-5。对 Anthropic-HH 数据集，由于没有 SFT 集合，我们使用构成 HH 数据集的二元比较中的偏好回答。这与先前工作一致（Yuan et al., 2023; Dong et al., 2023; Rafailov et al., 2023）。对摘要数据集，我们使用原始数据集标明的专用 SFT 集合。对 Llama 模型，我们发现 SFT 阶段 1 个 epoch 就够了。

25.text: In the RM stage, we train RM for 1 epoch with an initial learning rate of 1e-5.
25.zh: 在 RM 阶段，我们把 RM 训练 1 个 epoch，初始学习率为 1e-5。

25.text: For both RM and SFT training, we use a cosine decay learning schedule (Loshchilov & Hutter, 2016) and a 0.03 warm-up ratio.
25.zh: RM 和 SFT 的训练都使用余弦衰减的学习率日程（Loshchilov & Hutter, 2016），预热比例为 0.03。

25.text: For TL;DR Summarize dataset where we only experiment with Pythia models, we train each variant for 600 steps with a rollout batch-size of 512, and step batch-size of 256. We use a β value of 0.03.
25.zh: 对只使用 Pythia 模型做实验的 TL;DR Summarize 数据集，每个变体训练 600 步，rollout 的 batch 大小为 512，每步的 batch 大小为 256。β 取 0.03。
